name: agentic-framework
description: Multi-agent software engineering framework bundling 6 specialized subagents (architect, implementer, code-reviewer, security-auditor, debugger, verifier), 5 workflow skills (/adf-build, /adf-parallel, /adf-review, /adf-debug, /adf-ship), global routing rules, and a PreToolUse command safety gate.
suggestedPrompts: /adf-build Plan, implement, review, and verify a new feature end-to-end
/adf-review Run a parallel multi-angle audit (quality, security, architecture) on my changes
/adf-debug Run parallel root-cause hypothesis testing on a failing test or bug
